q: What is the minimum cement content for Class 4000 concrete made with crushed stone?
answer: 611 lb/cu yd (Structural Concrete Table, page 700-10)

q: Which class of concrete is used for foundation seals and underwater placement?
answer: Class 4000S (Note 1 of the Structural Concrete Table); 702.3.3.1 also allows 4000DS under water

q: How big does the proposal guaranty that comes with a bid have to be?
answer: 5% of the submitted bid

q: Can a bidder withdraw a bid after submitting it?
answer: Yes, before the date and time set for opening bids

q: How much clearance do overhanging trees need above the roadway after clearing and grubbing?
answer: 18 ft

q: To what density does each layer of embankment have to be compacted?
answer: Not less than 95.0% of maximum density (SC-T-29)

q: How long must concrete cure before backfilling to full height behind a new structure?
answer: At least 14 days when it causes unbalanced earth pressure; 3 days around piers or bents otherwise

q: How does SCDOT decide whether it is daytime or nighttime on a job?
answer: Light meter: daytime is 54 Lx (5 fc) or more, nighttime is less

q: Are lane closures on the interstate allowed over holiday weekends?
answer: No, prohibited during holiday weekends and extended holiday periods unless the RCE directs otherwise

q: How much notice must the contractor give before opening a new or widened bridge to traffic?
answer: Notify the RCE 4 weeks before

q: Does water from a city water system have to be tested before it goes into concrete?
answer: No, water from a public water supply may be accepted without testing

q: What happens if the 28-day cylinders break at 92% of the design strength?
answer: A price reduction applies (strength at least 90% of design but below it)

q: What is the longest the concrete for pavement can be hauled in a truck mixer before placement?
answer: 75 minutes in truck mixers or agitators

q: When is it too cold to place flowable fill?
answer: Do not place when ambient air is below 40°F; the fill must be at least 50°F at delivery

q: What application rate is used for the tack coat before paving over existing asphalt?
answer: 0.05 to 0.15 gal/sq yd

q: What training does a flagger need before flagging traffic?
answer: Successful completion of a Flagger Training course before flagging

q: How thick can each lift be when backfilling below a full depth asphalt patch?
answer: Layers not exceeding 4 in., compacted with a vibratory compactor

q: What is the maximum spacing between braced posts on a permanent fence?
answer: Brace corner, end, gate and pull posts at intervals of not more than 500 ft

q: What air content is required for the concrete used in full depth pavement patching?
answer: 3.0% to 6.0% per AASHTO T 152

q: How long do curing blankets have to stay on concrete placed in cold weather?
answer: A minimum of 4 days

q: What is the maximum curing temperature for a mass concrete pour that uses 25% Class F fly ash?
answer: 180°F (160°F for other mixes)

q: Who pays to uncover finished work so the RCE can inspect it?
answer: Paid as Extra Work if the work proves acceptable; at the Contractor's expense if it does not

q: What does Subsection 203.2.1.2 say unclassified excavation includes?
answer: Roadway and drainage excavation regardless of material or method, including the work in 203.2.1.3 through 203.2.1.8; the bid quantity is only an estimate

q: How wide must the reflective bands on drums and oversized cones be?
answer: 4 bands, 2 orange and 2 white, each not less than 6 in. wide, top band orange

q: How far outside the pavement does the subgrade need to be compacted?
answer: Between lines 18 in. outside the pavement structure, to not less than 95.0% of maximum density

note: Traffic law, not a construction spec
